column9: Chromebook support pages exist for middle and high school; Google Classroom guide for parents dated 2020; no earlier firm launch date found

GPSD Technology Device Distribution scheduled Dec 14-17 2020; 4-person tech team article mentions Chromebook replacement cycles and 9th-graders issued devices they keep through graduation; no earlier launch evidence found
March 2020 district COVID closure letter confirms all grades 6+ already had assigned Chromebooks; Canvas LMS in use for ~2 years prior; exact launch year pre-2020 not found
District has a 1:1 Chromebook initiative page; students expected to bring charged Chromebook for testing; no firm launch year found in web sources
Four-year project launched January 2014 to place Chromebooks in hands of all 3rd-8th graders within four years; Patch article confirms fast start; K-2 added later
District technology page exists; no specific 1:1 launch announcement found; confirmed Chromebook use at high school level; upper bound from website evidence
Aug 2021 article documents students picking up Chromebooks at school during open house; no earlier launch date found
Initial 1:1 initiative started in 2015 with 9th grade academy (~500 Chromebooks); expanded 2nd-12th grade via ESPLOST; 2018 added 580 more for K-1 (10/classroom not 1:1)
District website exists (pusdk8.us); El Dorado County region documented heavy Chromebook adoption; California COVID relief device programs 2020-21; no firm earlier date found
2016-17 WHMS handbook documents 1:1 Chromebook program for students; 2019-20 device use agreement confirms program existed; grades 2-12 assigned Chromebook for school and home use
District technology page confirms students receive Chromebook + case + earbuds + charger as 1:1 devices; no specific launch year found in web sources
2018-19 budget included Phase 3 of 1:1 initiative for grades 5-6 and HS math, implying grades 3-4 and some HS already had devices before FY19; phased rollout beginning at least by 2016
1:1 Chromebook initiative launched 2016-17 with 9th grade; by March 2017 over 4,200 Chromebooks deployed district-wide; August 2019 revised user agreement confirms K-12 program
Board approved $8.5M three-year initiative in March 2015; Phase 1 fall 2015 distributed ~3,300 Chromebooks to grades 3-9; HS upperclassmen 2016-17; K-2 in 2017-18
Phase 3 included distribution and training of students in summer 2013; professional development throughout 2012-13 SY; 1:1 iPad initiative for 7-12 initially
COVID-era 2020 chromebook shortage noted; Pre-K/K get iPads; grades 1-12 assigned Chromebooks; no earlier firm launch year for 1:1 found
District website mentions 1:1 Chromebook access for all students; COVID 2020-21 context; no earlier firm launch year found in web sources
District 1:1 Chromebook program confirmed; BCSD 1:1 handbook exists; all students receive Chromebook + charger for school and home use; no firm launch year pre-2020 found
District uses Chromebooks, PCs, and iPads; 2017 bond included technology upgrades; no explicit 1:1 launch year found; upper bound from website evidence
1:1 digital device initiative operational for over 8 years as of ~2024; grades K-8 use iPads, grades 9-10 use Windows laptops; HP Chromebook 11 cases ordered Sept 2016; started ~2016-17
Insurance portal opened Aug 26 2019 for the school year; all students 2nd grade and up assigned Chromebook during remote learning; references to Chromebook contracts at multiple schools
AUP 2021/22 policy document references student devices; district technology page confirms Chromebook support; no firm earlier launch year found
2020-21 Elementary Chromebook Information blog post confirms program; One Device Per Student program well-established; no earlier firm launch year found
Tech Revolution launched fall 2016-17 SY at Ritenour High School; every RHS student received a Chromebook; expanded to K-12 district-wide over subsequent years
IT department provides 1:1 Chromebook to student deployment; every student has access to educational content; no earlier firm launch year found
Students provided Chromebook in grades 3 and 7; high school students also have Chromebooks; Chromebook protection plan offered for grades 6-12; no firm launch year found
District 1:1 program confirmed; incoming 6th and 9th graders swap devices at back-to-school events; 2024 levy includes Chromebook refresh; no firm earlier launch year found
District equipped families with Chromebooks; 2020 connectivity challenges documented when ~30% students lacked internet; technology page confirms Chromebook use; no earlier firm launch year
Aug 2020 article documents Chromebook distribution to Klamath Falls City Schools students for fall; Klamath County SD is separate district but same region; no firm earlier launch year found
During 2018-19 SY all 6th-9th grade students issued Chromebooks for school and home use; treated like textbooks; 1:1 Chromebook Project site exists
USD 266 deploys Chromebook to grades 5-12; 1-to-1 deployment described as starting mid-2010s; no firm launch year pin-pointed in web sources
District serves K-8; no specific 1:1 launch year found in web searches; confirmed Chromebook use; upper bound from current website evidence
All students grades 5-12 receive individual Chromebooks for classroom and home use; e-learning days approved Dec 2020 enabled by existing Chromebook program; no earlier firm launch year
Pilot spring 2013 with ~100 6th graders; Oct 2013 board approved expansion to all 6th graders (~500 Chromebooks); Aug 18 2014 Batavia High School students (2,000+) received Chromebooks
District promotes learning through Chromebooks and technology; Bark monitoring in use; April 2025 board approved 4,000 Chromebook purchase; no earlier firm launch year found
District provides each student iPad or Chromebook for consistent learning environment; no specific 1:1 launch year found in web sources
1:1 program began fall 2012 with 5th and 6th graders at Sherwood Middle School; Jan 7 2015 School Committee voted to expand initiative; 2020-21 extended to K-4; district uses iPads not Chromebooks
District confirmed to have 1:1 device program; no specific launch year found; COVID-era distribution likely; limited web evidence pre-2020
Technology page confirms digital tools have replaced traditional textbooks; students use Springboro-managed Google Workspace; no firm launch year found
Digital classroom initiative launched 2015-16 SY; Chromebooks and tablets for all elementary students for ReadyGEN literacy program; HS planned for 2019-20
All students received iPads for 2019-20 school year; iPads distributed second week of school; district issues iPads to K-12
Golden LEAF Foundation grant 2017 for 800 Chromebooks; later $615K grant for middle and high school 1:1 program; universal Chromebook contract referenced; no precise launch year
Uniondale High School has dedicated Chromebook page for students; district-approved software list; no earlier firm launch year found
Every student in grades PK-12 has access to a Chromebook; district 1:1 Computing page with forms and resources; no specific launch year found in web sources
Grades K-2 assigned iPads; grades 3-12 assigned Chromebooks; recent policy change to limit elementary take-home use; no firm earlier launch year found
CHS and Cheldelin MS confirmed Chromebook use for students; internet filter on all student devices; no firm earlier launch year found
District 1:1 Initiative page exists; Chromebooks described as web-based devices; New Jersey 2014 standards referenced as driver; no firm earlier launch year pinpointed
EDGE program provides every student Chromebook as learning tool; all students have device access; Chromebook insurance available; handbook at district website; no firm launch year
Technology Services page confirmed; no specific 1:1 launch year found in web searches; upper bound from current website evidence
Board voted to approve iPad cases/chargers/adapters from Apple for $148,720 to support one-to-one initiative; earlier vote approved student iPads for $388,800; no precise launch year found
